events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont. Approximately 2-3 social events and 1-2 adventure rides.

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with practices and races. January: 2-4 indoor training opportunities. February: 1 weekend practice per week (2 hours). March-May: 2 rides per week including weeknight and weekend practices. Races begin early March, typically 5-6 races across NC through end of May. Racing happens all day Sunday with Saturday pre-rides.
events.venue: Asheville area and across North Carolina
